newsitem.title: NORWAY: Nycomed falls on price pressure talk.
newsitem.headline: Nycomed falls on price pressure talk.

text.p: Shares in Norwegian pharmaceuticals group Nycomed ASA fell heavily on Thursday amid analyst speculation of further price pressure in the U.S. market for X-ray diagnostic contrast agents, brokers said.
At 1335 GMT Nycomed's A stock stood 5.50 crowns, or 8.39 percent, down at 72 crowns, in 34.7 million crowns of trade.
The B stock also fell 5.50 crowns to 70 crowns in turnover of 20.3 million crowns.

"I recommended all my customers to sell as soon as possible," one analyst told Reuters. "How big the price fall is going to be and how far down the Nycomed share can go depends on the market strategy of Nycomed's competitors."
That analyst forecast Nycomed's A share to slide to 65 crowns by the end of the year.
